macro.name: Finger of Death

description.value:
You unleash negative energy toward a creature you can see within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 7d8 + 30 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

A Humanoid killed by this spell rises at the start of your next turn as a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmZombie00000000]{Zombie} that follows your verbal orders.

midi-qol: Automates the CON save and 7d8 + 30 necrotic damage (half on save). If a humanoid target is killed, a Zombie is automatically summoned at the start of the caster's next turn (or immediately if not in combat). The dead target's token is hidden when the zombie is raised.
